# DoKit

> DoKit is a free hub of online tools that run in your browser — no signup, no uploads, no watermark. Resize, compress and convert images, count words.

## Tools

- [DoKit Tools – All Free Online Tools](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/tools/): All DoKit tools run in your browser — image resizer, compressor, converter, word counter, case converter, board photo and password generator. Free and private.
- [Image Resizer – Resize JPG, PNG & WebP Free](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/tools/image-resizer/): Resize any image to exact pixels or a percentage, right in your browser. Your photos never leave your device — no signup, no watermark.
- [Compress Image to 100KB or Any Size Free](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/tools/image-compressor/): Compress JPG, PNG and WebP images to an exact file size — 50KB, 100KB, 200KB or your own target — privately in your browser.
- [Image Converter – PNG, JPG & WebP Converter](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/tools/image-converter/): Convert images between PNG, JPG, WebP and more in your browser. No uploads, no account, batch conversion included.
- [Word Counter – Words, Characters & Reading Time](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/tools/word-counter/): Paste any text and instantly count words, characters, sentences and reading time. Free, private, no signup.
- [Case Converter – Uppercase, Lowercase & Title Case](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/tools/case-converter/): Convert text to UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, Sentence case, camelCase, snake_case and more in one click.
- [Board Photo – Exam Photo Maker](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/tools/board-photo/): Make a board or university admission photo in the exact size and file size your board requires. Free, private, in your browser.
- [Password Generator](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/tools/password-generator/): Generate strong passwords in your browser. Uses your device's secure random generator — nothing leaves this page.
- [Unit Converter](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/tools/unit-converter/): Convert length, weight, temperature, volume and more between units. Pure maths, instant, in your browser.
- [QR Code Generator](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/tools/qr-generator/): Create QR codes for links and text in your browser. Uses a built-in generator — nothing is uploaded.

## Typing

- [Free Typing Test – WPM, Accuracy & Urdu Lessons](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/typing/): Take a free typing test, check your WPM and accuracy, follow 44 step-by-step lessons — including Urdu typing with a phonetic keyboard.
- [Typing Lessons – 44 Step-by-Step Lessons](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/typing/lessons/): All typing lessons from beginner keys to stories: practice each one in your browser, free.
- [Typing Lesson – Practice](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/typing/lesson/): Practise a typing lesson with live feedback, WPM and accuracy. Progress saves on this device.
- [Typing Practice – Free Practice Texts](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/typing/practice/): Practise typing with ready passages or your own text. Live WPM and accuracy; results save on this device.
- [Typing Results – My History](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/typing/results/): Your typing test, lesson, practice and battle results, saved on this device only.
- [Typing Progress – My Stats](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/typing/progress/): Your typing progress from on-device history: sessions, best WPM, average accuracy, lessons completed.
- [Typing Dashboard](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/typing/dashboard/): Your typing hub: local progress summary and links to every typing page.
- [Typing Games – Word Fall & Word Sprint](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/typing/games/): Learn while you play: Word Fall and Word Sprint typing games with best scores saved on this device.
- [Urdu Typing – Phonetic Keyboard & Practice](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/typing/urdu/): Type Urdu with a standard phonetic layout: convert Roman text to Urdu, or practise with the on-screen keyboard.
- [Typing FAQ](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/typing/faq/): How DoKit typing lessons, tests, practice and progress work — plain answers, no hype.
- [Typing Certificate](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/typing/certificate/): How DoKit typing certificates work: what they show, and when issuing arrives.
- [Verify Certificate](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/typing/verify/): Check a DoKit certificate ID against issued records.
- [Typing Profile](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/typing/profile/): Your typing profile: local stats plus your account card.
- [Games](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/games/): Typing games and TypeFight battles: play Word Fall, Word Sprint, or race in TypeFight.

## TypeFight

- [TypeFight – Typing Battles](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/typefight/): TypeFight turns typing into a sport: enter a room, race the same text, fastest and most accurate wins.
- [TypeFight Battle – 60 Second Race](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/typefight/battle/): Race the same text for 60 seconds against bots. Live leaderboard, WPM and accuracy.
- [TypeFight Wallet](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/typefight/wallet/): Your real coin balance, synced from your account — coins earned from typing, battles and referrals, with your full history. Check your balance any time.
- [Fighter Profile](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/typefight/profile/): Your TypeFight battle identity, saved to your account — fighter name, battle stats, wins and certificates. Set up your profile before your next race.
- [Battle Certificates](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/typefight/certificate/): TypeFight battle certificates. Battle results show as practice certificates.
- [Verify Battle Certificate](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/typefight/verify/): Check a TypeFight certificate against issued records.

## Guides

- [DoKit Guides – How to Resize, Compress & More](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/guides/): Practical how-tos for everyday image work: resize without losing quality, and compress to an exact KB target.
- [How to Resize an Image Without Losing Quality](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/guides/how-to-resize-image-without-losing-quality/): Keep the aspect ratio locked, resize from the original, and pick the right format — JPG for photos, PNG for graphics, WebP for the web.
- [How to Compress an Image to 100KB](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/guides/how-to-compress-image-to-100kb/): Forms and portals reject oversized photos. Learn how to hit an exact KB target without ruining quality — then do it free in your browser.
- [How to convert text case](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/guides/convert-case/): Fix ALL-CAPS headings, lowercase SHOUTING, and format titles perfectly — six case styles, one click each.
- [How to convert image formats](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/guides/convert-images/): Switch any image between JPG, PNG and WebP in seconds — smaller files, wider compatibility, zero uploads.
- [How to count words](https://aleemurrehman803.github.io/DoKit/guides/count-words/): Instant word counts, reading time and keyword stats for essays, articles, captions and scripts.
